neighbours.label: In English, a digit right after 'a', 'an', 'the' or a possessive, in the describing slot of a number-hyphen compound ('a 20-minute wait', 'an 18-year-old'). Quiet for the same numbers after verbs or prepositions ('waited 20 minutes', 'for 18 years'), years and plain counts. Spelled-out numbers are unreliable; words inside long hyphen chains (URL slugs) also fire.
neighbours.short: a digit in a number-hyphen compound after a determiner
neighbours.notes: Step-in reader of bonsai1/L34/N4384- (its top feeder). Tops peak on the last piece of a word about to be hyphen-joined (jackal|-headed, diabetes|-related, tenth|-most); output suppresses '-based', '-related', '-like'. Probes: digits after a/an 0.28-0.41, after the/possessive ~0.16-0.19; 'ever' (ever-greater) 0.40, 'a once' 0.37, 'ninth-largest and tenth' 0.57; plain nouns ~0.05. Solver leak: Spanish URL slug 0.65. Blind test written from the label only.
fire: We sat through a 20-minute wait before the doctor called us in.
An 18-year-old won the regional chess title this weekend.
The 5-page report was due on Friday morning.
She signed a 3-year lease on the apartment downtown.
My 12-hour shift finally ended at dawn.
The town built a 40-foot statue near the harbor.
He ran a 10-kilometer race in under an hour.
quiet: We waited 20 minutes before the doctor called us in.
She has lived in the village for 18 years.
The report was 5 pages long and due on Friday.
She signed the lease in 2019 and moved downtown.
My shift lasted 12 hours and ended at dawn.
The statue near the harbor stands 40 feet tall.
He ran 10 kilometers in under an hour.

predictions: Most 'a'-led fire items above 0.25; 'The 5' and 'My 12' closer to 0.2; near misses under 0.1.
